title: Применить storage truth contract ко всем prepared representations
summary: Исправить NEW-2: Scan/Word/Spreadsheet/Gsfx representations становятся persisted/Ready/Prepared только после checked object write и идемпотентной DB finalization. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:297-321`).
why: Каждая strategy игнорирует false `put`, создаёт phantom `DocumentRepresentation`, а Prepare job переводит документ в `Prepared`, после чего screening читает отсутствующий объект. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/findings-00-source-synthesis.json`, NEW-2).

include: shared representation writer/finalizer; false/exception/readback contract; atomic representation metadata + Prepared transition; stale metadata/missing object healing; matrix over OCR PDF/text, Word PDF, spreadsheet PDF/text-grid and GSFX structured/text outputs; Prepare job retry behavior.
exclude: format-selection policy changes; OCR quality; timeouts (P3.5); source versions (P3.2); live storage performance.

rules: One shared writer owns side-effect verification; one Action owns DB finalization. Strategy returns Ready only after verified object+metadata. Any required multi-output representation is all-or-nothing at state level: partial objects may be cleanup debt but no Prepared claim. Duplicate retry converges. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).
guidance: Dataset-driven fault matrix names every strategy/output and injects false at each write position. Assert no representation row/status Prepared on partial failure; retry succeeds exactly once without duplicating rows. Do not copy four ad-hoc `if (! put)` implementations; reuse the shared contract without changing format semantics. Verify behavior through strategy/job public interfaces. If multi-output rollback cannot delete an object safely, record orphan key for cleanup but keep DB status non-success.
